title: IDF Strikes Continue Across Gaza on Day 964 as Hamas Warns of 'Dangerous Escalation'
detail: Israeli airstrikes, artillery shelling, and drone strikes continued across the Gaza Strip on June 1, 2026 (Day 964), as Hamas issued a formal warning of a 'dangerous escalation' following Netanyahu's May 29 directive to extend IDF territorial control from 60% to 70% of Gaza. The Times of Israel liveblog reported multiple strikes throughout the day. Palestinian medics documented ongoing casualties as Israel pressed forward with military operations in northern, central, and southern Gaza. The offensive has shown no signs of abating as ceasefire Phase II talks remain fully deadlocked — Hamas insists on a guaranteed, permanent end to the war and full Israeli withdrawal, while Israel demands Hamas disarmament as a precondition. The UN has warned that Gaza risks becoming permanently divided between Israeli-controlled areas and a shrinking Hamas-held pocket.

media.caption: IDF continues strikes across Gaza as Hamas warns of dangerous escalation — June 1, 2026

title: Israel's Supreme Court Clears Path for New Mossad Director Gofman — Transition Effective June 2
detail: Israel's Supreme Court on June 1, 2026 (Day 964) cleared the legal path for the new Mossad Director, Gofman, to take over the intelligence agency effective June 2. The transition marks a significant shift in Israeli intelligence leadership during an active military campaign. The Mossad has played a central role in the Gaza war, including targeted killings of Hamas leadership figures such as Ismail Haniyeh (July 2024), Yahya Sinwar (October 2024), Mohammed Sinwar (May 2026), and Mohammed Odeh (May 2026). The new Mossad leadership will oversee ongoing operations against Hamas's remaining military structure and participate in ceasefire negotiations.

media.caption: Israel Supreme Court clears path for new Mossad director Gofman, effective June 2, 2026
